decisions.reason: Because this finned-tube offer fits the firm's core heat-exchanger business, can support both equipment sales and aftermarket work, and has survived longer than the 2018 launches that were quickly withdrawn, its performance likely meets a minimally satisfactory aspiration level despite some portfolio-pruning risk.

Because enhanced heat exchanger tubes draw directly on the firm's R&D and engineering strengths, complement modernization and efficiency-oriented customer demand, and appear to have remained viable after other weaker launches were dropped, management would likely retain them unless results deteriorate sharply.
